claim: Henderson et al. show that swapping only the codebase/implementation (e.g. OpenAI baselines TRPO vs. original Schulman 2015 TRPO vs. rllab TensorFlow TRPO), with hyperparameters and algorithm held fixed, produces dramatic differences in final average return on HalfCheetah-v1.
stance_target: N8: does prior work show implementation/library-version variance moving results by an order comparable to method differences under study?
scope_conditions: Continuous-control deep RL, TRPO/DDPG on HalfCheetah-v1, 2M-sample training runs
quoted_support: We find that implementation differences which are often not reflected in publications can have dramatic impacts on performance.
numbers: DDPG codebase-comparison average return range approx. 0-5000

claim: Henderson et al.'s own significance testing finds an inter-algorithm comparison (ACKTR vs. DDPG on Walker2d-v1) statistically non-significant with overlapping confidence intervals, while their codebase-swap ablation on the same paper's HalfCheetah-v1 DDPG experiment produces a return spread of comparable or larger relative magnitude.
stance_target: N8: is implementation/codebase variance the same order of magnitude as the method differences a benchmark paper studies?
scope_conditions: Walker2d-v1 (ACKTR vs DDPG significance test) and HalfCheetah-v1 (DDPG codebase ablation)
quoted_support: t = 1.03, p = 0.334, KS = 0.40, p = 0.697, bootstrapped percent difference 44.47% (-80.62%, 111.72%)

claim: Henderson et al. never use the words 'platform,' 'operating system,' 'macOS,' 'Linux,' or 'cross-platform'; their variance source is codebase/reimplementation choice, not OS-level platform difference.
stance_target: N8 exact framing: literal cross-OS platform dependence documented
quoted_support: codebase(s): 20+ hits ... platform: 0 hits ... GPU: 0 hits

claim: Henderson et al. conclude that both intrinsic (random seeds, environment properties) and extrinsic (hyperparameters, codebases) sources of non-determinism contribute to difficulties reproducing baseline RL algorithms, generalizing the codebase-variance finding.
stance_target: N8: general documentation that implementation-level factors move benchmark results
quoted_support: We find that both intrinsic (e.g. random seeds, environment properties) and extrinsic sources (e.g. hyperparameters, codebases) of non-determinism can contribute to difficulties in reproducing baseline algorithms.
